row.team_price_text: Optimize: $159/mo billed annually ($199 monthly), 3 team seats
row.evidence: Leadpages users are invited manually ("Invite team members by adding users to your Leadpages account"); the only SSO is Google sign-in, which "is currently only available to the account owner", and no SAML or SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New row. Flat plans (annual): Grow $79/mo, Optimize $159/mo, Scale $319/mo (HTML Pub publishing plans from $8/mo); per-user fields stay null. Pricing page gives team seats only on Optimize (3) and Scale (10), while the help centre says Grow 5, Optimize 10, Scale 25 (see conflicts; pricing page used). No SAML/OIDC SSO with a customer IdP: Google social login is owner-only. Users are invited and removed by hand; removing a user does not change the subscription. Okta's LeadPages app is SWA (password vaulting). REST API (Grow+) has no user endpoints. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Pricing page: team seats not included.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 10 team seats, workspaces and audit logs (UI) per pricing page.

scim.notes: No SCIM or SAML in the pricing comparison (Team + Admin lists team seats, workspaces, audit logs), developer docs, security page or help centre (search 'scim' and 'okta' return 0 articles). Only Google social login exists, and only for the account owner. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are a Scale-plan feature on the pricing page; no API documented.

user_api.notes: The public REST API (Grow and above) covers pages, sites, library, blogs, analytics, forms, custom domains and brand kits; it has no user, member or role endpoints.

okta.notes: OIN app is SWA (password vaulting), last updated 2014.
